## Names

<a id="swap_pictures"></a>
### [`swap_pictures`](../../../../src/tools/swap.asm#L6) `$3696`

*routine*

Exchanges the picture with the second picture: blanks the screen, runs swap_script, sets the background colour, and shows the screen again.

- **Called from:** [`copy_tool`](copy.md#copy_tool) [`$3482`](../../../../src/tools/copy.asm#L67), [`copy_tool`](copy.md#copy_tool) [`$34E2`](../../../../src/tools/copy.asm#L122), [`swap_tool`](swap.md#swap_tool) [`$36C9`](../../../../src/tools/swap.asm#L31)
- **Calls:** [`screen_off`](../init/screen.md#screen_off), [`run_script`](../script/interpreter.md#run_script)
- **Jumps to:** [`screen_on`](../init/screen.md#screen_on)
- **Reads:** [`background_colour`](../../memory-map.md#background_colour)
- **Writes:** [`BGCOL0`](../../memory-map.md#BGCOL0)

<a id="swap_tool"></a>
### [`swap_tool`](../../../../src/tools/swap.asm#L15) `$36A8`

*routine*

Swap (command $0e, from the command table at $0d74). Shows the picture with the tool label (script $2f6d). Each press exchanges the picture with the second picture. No touch and a long press ends the tool ($1495).

- **Entry of:** [`command_table`](../../tables.md#command_table)
- **Calls:** [`start_tool`](tool_start.md#start_tool), [`wait_button_up`](../menu/menu.md#wait_button_up), [`update_cursor`](../input/cursor.md#update_cursor), [`long_press_off_pad`](../input/buttons.md#long_press_off_pad), [`button_pressed`](../input/buttons.md#button_pressed), [`swap_pictures`](swap.md#swap_pictures)
- **Jumps to:** [`tool_exit`](tool_exit.md#tool_exit)
- **Reads:** [`cursor_x`](../../memory-map.md#cursor_x)
- **Writes:** [`cursor_sprite_mask`](../../memory-map.md#cursor_sprite_mask)

<a id="swap_script"></a>
### [`swap_script`](../../../../src/tools/swap.asm#L36) `$36D2-$3708`

*data*

Script: calls $1dd3, then exchanges $6000-$7f3f with $e000, $c000-$c3e7 with $d800, $c3e8-$c7cf with $dc00 and $c7d0 with $dfe8 (op 4 swaps with I/O and ROM off), then calls $1dfe.
